recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for current FHIR source unless a future review identifies an obsolete DSTU1 artifact still being generated outside the current build.
issue_request: FHIR-6152 asked to correct the typo in section 6.17.5.2 from "there can be more than element for the same path" to "there can be more than one element for the same path". The issue is Published, Persuasive, non-substantive, and assigned to FHIR-I for FHIR-core StructureDefinition.
initial_application: Jira comments record application in SVN revision 5355 and then state "already fixed". Current Git history searches for FHIR-6152, revision 5355, and the exact malformed text did not find a traceable implementation commit in the relevant current files, so the historical application appears to predate or sit outside the current Git-traceable history.
additional_context: The old DSTU1 StructureDefinition narrative has been refactored into the active ElementDefinition page. source/fhir.ini lists ElementDefinition as a current datatype, marks it normative, and assigns its abbreviation. Current source describes ElementDefinition.path without the malformed phrase, and no Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the requested typo is not present in the current active source and adding replacement wording would be redundant editorial churn.
